name: Adobe Express
tagline: Template-based quick editor for social graphics, videos, PDFs, and assets

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; 2026 public coverage lists Premium at $9.99/month or $99.99/year.

verdictSummary: You can build a quick image editor and template exporter, but Adobe's stock/licensing, PDF/media tooling, brand assets, and Creative Cloud tie-ins are the product.
coreLoopDIY: Build a small template editor for images/videos with text overlays, background removal via API, and export.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the content and export ecosystem is already there.

priorArt.name: GrapesJS
priorArt.desc: Open-source visual builder useful for layout/template-editor concepts, though not a full E

notes: Useful contrast with Canva: same template moat, different ecosystem.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Adobe Express (Template-based quick editor for social graphics, videos, PDFs, and assets). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build a small template editor for images/videos with text overlays, background removal via API, and export.
- Needs: canvas/video editor.
- Needs: media processing.
- Needs: image AI API.
- Needs: template assets.
- Needs: storage.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: Adobe Stock/assets; PDF/video tooling; brand kits.
